meta.description: Senior Software Engineer. 4 years at Ubidots, an IoT platform with 150K+ users. React, mobile apps, real-time systems. Remote since 2021. IEEE-published author.
about.heading: Four years optimizing the frontend of a 150K-user platform. Now building developer tools.
about.bio_1: At Ubidots, there was an ECharts widget that took up to 30 seconds to render. Nobody filed a bug report — users just closed the tab. I found it in a DevTools session at 11pm.
about.bio_2: I worked as a Senior Engineer at Ubidots, an IoT platform with 150K+ users and millions of real-time events. Outside of code, I'm a speaker, mentor, and published author at IEEE Xplore.

press.bio_p1: Christian Elías Cruz González is a senior software engineer from Mixquiahuala de Juárez, Hidalgo, Mexico, specializing in high-performance interfaces, mobile applications, and real-time systems. His work bridges product development and technical research: he is a published author in IEEE Xplore and the author of an Internet-Draft submitted to the IETF — two spaces rarely occupied by the same person.
press.bio_p2: He has spoken at international technology conferences and has been interviewed by television and radio media in Mexico. He has worked remotely since 2021.

testimonials.heading: What people I've worked with say
testimonials.q1: His professionalism and technical skills are outstanding, but above all, his human qualities are remarkable. He always remembers that even though we work in technology, we work with humans.
testimonials.q2: An excellent developer with great skills in web development, with a natural leadership ability and great teaching skills.
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.desc: From student in Hidalgo to senior engineer with products of his own: code, papers, talks, and the occasional pigeon — on a single timeline.
timeline.end: The line keeps growing. If you want to be part of the next milestone, let's talk.
api.desc: This site's data as public JSON endpoints, generated on every build from the same sources that feed the pages. No auth, no rate limits, no surprises.
api.note: All endpoints are GET, static, and read-only. Localized fields are delivered as { es, en, lat } objects. If you build something with this, I'd love to hear about it: contacto@christianecg.com.
